title: Objects over Ellsworth runway, weapons storage and B-52 alert pad

tellings.quote: I probably heard about four or five other cases and not just in the missile field, but back at Ellsworth also, of objects coming down the runway

plain: Between about 1957 and 1959, unknown objects are said to have come down the runway at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota and over its weapons storage area and its B-52 alert pad, where nuclear bombers stood ready. Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran, says he heard about "four or five other cases" like this, at the base and out in the missile fields. If true, these objects were taking an interest in American nuclear forces.
